description: Responses of GET /api/pantins/:pantinId/io (IoMappingResponse, ADR 0045 point 7), shared by the core's Zod schema and the Python bridge's decoder. Each `message` is a decoded JSON answer. Every decoder must accept every `valid` entry and refuse every `invalid` one. The pairing of a zone with an io type is checked by the core's validation, not by the schema, so no entry here depends on it.

valid.name: a valid mapping with two modules and every zone
an invalid mapping with a problem on a line
an invalid mapping with a problem that has no line

invalid.name: unmappedTags with a bad tag name
module with an unknown word order
row with an unknown io type
